<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var ENDPOINTS = {
    status: new URL('api/status', location.href).toString(),
    metrics: new URL('api/metrics', location.href).toString(),
    artifacts: new URL('api/artifacts', location.href).toString()
  };
  var BASE_INTERVAL = { status: 3000, metrics: 10000, artifacts: 12000 };
  var HIDDEN_FACTOR = 5;
  var STALE_MS = 60000;
  var MAX_POINTS_DRAWN = 1500;
  var MAX_LOG_LINES = 100;
  var POINT_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;
  var CHART_PAD = { l: 62, r: 16, t: 14, b: 40 };
  var UNIT_LABEL = { ratio: '比例 0–1' };

  var STATES = {
    implementing: { text: '编程中', tone: 'info' },
    checking: { text: '检查中', tone: 'info' },
    waiting_resource: { text: '等待资源', tone: 'warn' },
    training: { text: '训练中', tone: 'ok' },
    evaluating: { text: '评测中', tone: 'ok' },
    stage_end: { text: '阶段结束', tone: 'ok' },
    failed: { text: '失败', tone: 'bad' },
    needs_user: { text: '需要用户处理', tone: 'warn' }
  };
  var DATA_KIND = {
    libero_dequantized: 'LIBERO 逆处理/量化缓存',
    libero_uint8: 'LIBERO 逆处理/量化缓存',
    hdr_derived: 'RoboTwin HDR 派生',
    real_cfa: '真实 CFA'
  };
  var ARM_KEYS = ['raw_base', 'raw_n01', 'rgb_base', 'rgb_n01'];
  var STAGES = ['P3', 'P4', 'P5', 'P6', 'P7', 'P8'];

  var S = {
    status: null,
    statusError: null,
    statusOkAt: 0,
    metrics: null,
    metricsError: null,
    metricsOkAt: 0,
    apiArtifacts: null,
    artifactsError: null,
    artifactsUnsupported: false,
    selectedCase: null,
    logSignature: ''
  };

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    var node = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) node.className = cls;
    if (text != null) node.textContent = String(text);
    return node;
  }
  function arr(value) { return Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; }
  function obj(value) { return (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) ? value : null; }
  function num(value) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return null;
    var n = Number(value);
    return isFinite(n) ? n : null;
  }
  function str(value) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
    return String(value);
  }
  function hasText(value) { return str(value).trim().length > 0; }
  function fmtInt(value) {
    var n = num(value);
    return n === null ? null : Math.round(n).toLocaleString('zh-CN');
  }
  function fmtFixed(value, digits) {
    var n = num(value);
    if (n === null) return null;
    return n.toFixed(digits === undefined ? 2 : digits);
  }
  function fmtDuration(seconds) {
    var s = num(seconds);
    if (s === null || s < 0) return null;
    s = Math.round(s);
    var d = Math.floor(s / 86400), h = Math.floor((s % 86400) / 3600), m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60), sec = s % 60;
    if (d > 0) return d + ' 天 ' + h + ' 小时';
    if (h > 0) return h + ' 小时 ' + m + ' 分';
    if (m > 0) return m + ' 分 ' + sec + ' 秒';
    return sec + ' 秒';
  }
  function fmtAge(ms) {
    if (ms === null || ms === undefined || !isFinite(ms)) return null;
    var s = Math.max(0, Math.round(ms / 1000));
    if (s < 60) return s + ' 秒';
    if (s < 3600) return Math.floor(s / 60) + ' 分 ' + (s % 60) + ' 秒';
    if (s < 86400) return Math.floor(s / 3600) + ' 小时 ' + Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60) + ' 分';
    return Math.floor(s / 86400) + ' 天 ' + Math.floor((s % 86400) / 3600) + ' 小时';
  }
  function fmtClock(value) {
    if (!hasText(value)) return null;
    var ms = Date.parse(value);
    if (!isFinite(ms)) return str(value) + '（时间格式无法解析）';
    return new Date(ms).toLocaleString('zh-CN', { hour12: false, timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai' });
  }
  function parseMs(value) {
    if (!hasText(value)) return null;
    var ms = Date.parse(value);
    return isFinite(ms) ? ms : null;
  }
  function fmtCount(value, suffix) {
    var out = fmtInt(value);
    if (out === null) return null;
    return suffix ? out + ' ' + suffix : out;
  }
  function fmtGiB(mib) {
    var n = num(mib);
    if (n === null) return null;
    return (n / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' GiB';
  }
  function joinParts(parts, sep) {
    return parts.filter(function (p) { return hasText(p); }).join(sep === undefined ? ' · ' : sep);
  }
  function dataKindLabel(kind) {
    if (!hasText(kind)) return null;
    var key = str(kind).trim();
    return DATA_KIND[key] || (key + '（未登记来源说明）');
  }
  function unitLabel(unit) {
    var key = str(unit).trim();
    if (!key) return '单位未标注';
    return UNIT_LABEL[key] || key;
  }
  function domainOf(run) {
    var explicit = str(run && run.input_domain).trim();
    if (explicit) return explicit.toUpperCase();
    var method = str(run && run.method).toLowerCase();
    if (method.indexOf('rgb') >= 0) return 'RGB';
    if (method.indexOf('raw') >= 0) return 'RAW';
    return '';
  }
  var BENIGN_EXIT = /^(completed?|finished?|done|success(ful)?|normal|正常|正常完成|完成|成功|结束|已停止)$/i;
  function exitInfo(run) {
    var alive = run ? run.alive : undefined;
    var reason = str(run && run.exit_reason).trim();
    if (alive === true) return { text: '存活', tone: 'ok', abnormal: false };
    if (alive === false) {
      if (reason && BENIGN_EXIT.test(reason)) return { text: '已完成（退出原因 ' + reason + '）', tone: 'info', abnormal: false };
      if (reason) return { text: '已退出：' + reason, tone: 'bad', abnormal: true };
      return { text: '已退出（未记录退出原因）', tone: 'muted', abnormal: false };
    }
    return { text: '存活状态未登记', tone: 'muted', abnormal: false };
  }
  function runMethod(run) {
    if (hasText(run && run.method)) return str(run.method).trim();
    if (hasText(run && run.role)) return str(run.role).trim();
    return '';
  }
  function armKeyOf(method) {
    var key = str(method).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (ARM_KEYS.indexOf(key) >= 0) return key;
    var domain = key.indexOf('rgb') >= 0 ? 'rgb' : key.indexOf('raw') >= 0 ? 'raw' : '';
    var variant = key.indexOf('n01') >= 0 ? 'n01' : key.indexOf('base') >= 0 ? 'base' : '';
    return domain && variant ? domain + '_' + variant : '';
  }
  function resolveUrl(url) {
    var raw = str(url);
    if (!raw) return '';
    try { return new URL(raw, location.href).toString(); } catch (err) { return raw; }
  }
  function cssVar(name) {
    var value = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name);
    return (value || '').trim() || '#888';
  }
  function isVideoArtifact(a) {
    if (str(a.kind).toLowerCase() === 'video') return true;
    return /\.(mp4|webm|mov|m4v|ogv)(\?|#|$)/i.test(str(a.url));
  }

  /* ---------- fetch ---------- */
  function getJson(url) {
    var controller = new AbortController();
    var timer = setTimeout(function () { controller.abort(); }, POINT_TIMEOUT_MS);
    return fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store', signal: controller.signal, headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (!res.ok) {
          var err = new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
          err.status = res.status;
          throw err;
        }
        return res.json();
      })
      .finally(function () { clearTimeout(timer); });
  }

  var inflight = { status: false, metrics: false, artifacts: false };

  function pollStatus() {
    if (inflight.status) return Promise.resolve();
    inflight.status = true;
    return getJson(ENDPOINTS.status).then(function (data) {
      S.status = data;
      S.statusError = null;
      S.statusOkAt = Date.now();
    }).catch(function (err) {
      S.statusError = err;
    }).finally(function () {
      inflight.status = false;
      renderStatus();
    });
  }

  function pollMetrics() {
    if (inflight.metrics) return Promise.resolve();
    inflight.metrics = true;
    return getJson(ENDPOINTS.metrics).then(function (data) {
      S.metrics = data;
      S.metricsError = null;
      S.metricsOkAt = Date.now();
    }).catch(function (err) {
      S.metricsError = err;
    }).finally(function () {
      inflight.metrics = false;
      renderMetrics();
    });
  }

  function pollArtifacts() {
    if (inflight.artifacts || S.artifactsUnsupported) return Promise.resolve();
    inflight.artifacts = true;
    return getJson(ENDPOINTS.artifacts).then(function (data) {
      S.apiArtifacts = data;
      S.artifactsError = null;
    }).catch(function (err) {
      S.artifactsError = err;
      if (err && err.status === 404) S.artifactsUnsupported = true;
    }).finally(function () {
      inflight.artifacts = false;
      renderArtifacts();
    });
  }

  function loop(task, baseMs) {
    var tick = function () {
      task().catch(function () { /* 单项失败不阻断轮询 */ })
        .then(function () { setTimeout(tick, document.hidden ? baseMs * HIDDEN_FACTOR : baseMs); });
    };
    return tick();
  }

  /* ---------- header ---------- */
  function dataAgeOf(st) {
    var updatedMs = obj(st) ? parseMs(st.updated_at) : null;
    return updatedMs === null ? null : Date.now() - updatedMs;
  }

  function renderClockLines(st) {
    var lastOkAge = S.statusOkAt ? Date.now() - S.statusOkAt : null;
    var connParts = [];
    if (S.statusOkAt) {
      connParts.push('最后成功读取 ' + new Date(S.statusOkAt).toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour12: false }) + (lastOkAge !== null ? '（' + fmtAge(lastOkAge) + '前）' : ''));
    } else {
      connParts.push('尚未成功读取 api/status');
    }
    if (S.statusError) connParts.push('最近一次请求失败：' + (S.statusError.message || S.statusError.name));
    $('conn-line').textContent = connParts.join(' · ');

    var dataAge = dataAgeOf(st);
    if (!obj(st)) {
      $('stale-line').textContent = '数据新鲜度未知';
    } else if (dataAge === null) {
      $('stale-line').textContent = 'updated_at 缺失，无法判断新鲜度';
    } else if (dataAge > STALE_MS) {
      $('stale-line').textContent = '进度数据较久未更新（' + fmtAge(dataAge) + '）';
    } else {
      $('stale-line').textContent = '数据新鲜（' + fmtAge(dataAge) + '前更新）';
    }
    return dataAge;
  }

  function renderStatus() {
    var st = obj(S.status);
    var state = obj(st) && hasText(st.state) ? str(st.state).trim() : '';
    var stage = obj(st) && hasText(st.stage) ? str(st.stage).trim() : '';

    $('hdr-stage').textContent = stage || '阶段未登记';
    $('hdr-activity').textContent = obj(st) && hasText(st.activity) ? str(st.activity) : (obj(st) ? '尚未登记当前活动' : '等待 api/status…');

    var meta = [];
    var current = obj(st) && obj(st.current_run);
    if (current) {
      if (hasText(current.method)) meta.push('当前 run ' + str(current.method));
      if (hasText(current.platform)) meta.push('平台 ' + str(current.platform));
      var kind = dataKindLabel(current.data_kind);
      if (kind) meta.push('数据来源 ' + kind);
    }
    if (obj(st) && hasText(st.updated_at)) meta.push('status.updated_at ' + (fmtClock(st.updated_at) || str(st.updated_at)));
    $('hdr-source').textContent = meta.length ? meta.join(' · ') : '等待服务端提供 current_run / updated_at';

    var mapped = STATES[state] || { text: state || '状态未知', tone: 'muted' };
    var badge = $('state-badge');
    badge.setAttribute('data-tone', mapped.tone);
    $('state-text').textContent = state ? (STATES[state] ? mapped.text : state + '（未知状态）') : '状态未登记';

    renderClockLines(st);
    renderBanner(st, state, dataAgeOf(st));
    renderCards(st);
    renderArmTable(st);
    renderGpuTable(st);
    renderRuns(st);
    renderTasks(st);
    renderLog(st);
    renderArtifacts();
  }

  function tickClocks() {
    var st = obj(S.status);
    var state = st && hasText(st.state) ? str(st.state).trim() : '';
    renderClockLines(st);
    renderBanner(st, state, dataAgeOf(st));
  }

  function renderBanner(st, state, dataAge) {
    var banner = $('banner');
    var messages = [];
    var tone = 'info';
    var rank = { info: 0, warn: 1, bad: 2 };
    var push = function (text, nextTone) {
      if (!hasText(text)) return;
      messages.push(text);
      if (rank[nextTone] > rank[tone]) tone = nextTone;
    };
    if (!obj(st)) {
      if (S.statusError) {
        push('未连接服务：读取 api/status 失败（' + (S.statusError.message || S.statusError.name) + '）。' +
          (location.protocol === 'file:' ? '本页正以 file:// 直接打开，没有同源 HTTP 服务；请通过服务地址访问，例如 http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/ 。' : '将按正常节奏自动重试，无需刷新。'), 'warn');
      } else {
        push('正在连接服务…首次读取 api/status。', 'info');
      }
    } else {
      if (S.statusError) {
        push('连接中断：保留最后成功读取的进度数据（最后成功 ' +
          (S.statusOkAt ? new Date(S.statusOkAt).toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour12: false }) : '未知') +
          '；错误 ' + (S.statusError.message || S.statusError.name) + '）。正在按正常节奏自动重试，恢复后本提示自动消失。', 'bad');
      }
      if (state === 'failed') {
        push('运行状态为 failed：失败判定来自服务端 state（进程/退出状态），本页不根据数据陈旧自行判定失败。', 'bad');
      }
      var dead = arr(obj(st) && st.runs).filter(function (r) { return exitInfo(r).abnormal; });
      if (dead.length) {
        push('有 worker 异常退出：' + dead.map(function (r) {
          return (runMethod(r) || '未登记方法') + '（退出原因 ' + str(r.exit_reason) + '）';
        }).join('；') + '。正常完成（exit_reason=completed）不计为失败。', 'bad');
      }
      if (dataAge !== null && dataAge > STALE_MS) {
        push('进度数据较久未更新：updated_at 距今约 ' + fmtAge(dataAge) + '。这可能只是写入停顿，不代表训练失败；失败只依据进程/退出状态。', 'warn');
      }
    }
    if (!messages.length) {
      banner.hidden = true;
      banner.textContent = '';
      return;
    }
    banner.hidden = false;
    banner.setAttribute('data-tone', tone);
    banner.textContent = messages.join(' ');
  }

  function renderCards(st) {
    var current = obj(st) && obj(st.current_run);
    var runs = arr(obj(st) && st.runs);
    var matched = current && hasText(current.method) ? findRun(runs, current.method, current.platform, current.seed) : null;
    var rollouts = obj(current) && obj(current.rollouts) ? current.rollouts : (matched ? obj(matched.rollouts) : null);

    /* 卡片 ① */
    if (obj(current) && (hasText(current.method) || hasText(current.platform))) {
      $('card1-value').textContent = hasText(current.method) ? str(current.method) : '方法未登记';
      $('card1-note').textContent = joinParts([
        hasText(current.input_domain) ? '输入域 ' + str(current.input_domain) : null,
        hasText(current.platform) ? '平台 ' + str(current.platform) : null,
        num(current.seed) !== null ? '训练种子 ' + fmtInt(current.seed) : '训练种子未登记',
        dataKindLabel(current.data_kind) ? '数据来源 ' + dataKindLabel(current.data_kind) : '数据来源未登记'
      ]);
    } else {
      $('card1-value').textContent = '尚未测量';
      $('card1-note').textContent = '等待 current_run.method / platform / seed';
    }

    /* 卡片 ② */
    var step = obj(current) ? num(current.step) : null;
    var planned = obj(current) ? num(current.planned_steps) : null;
    var rolloutLine = rollouts
      ? joinParts([
        num(rollouts.completed_rollouts) !== null ? '已完成 ' + fmtInt(rollouts.completed_rollouts) + ' / ' + (num(rollouts.expected_rollouts) !== null ? fmtInt(rollouts.expected_rollouts) : '未登记分母') : null,
        num(rollouts.successes) !== null ? '成功 ' + fmtInt(rollouts.successes) : null,
        num(rollouts.failures) !== null ? '正常失败 ' + fmtInt(rollouts.failures) : null,
        num(rollouts.infra_pending) !== null ? 'infra 待恢复 ' + fmtInt(rollouts.infra_pending) : null
      ])
      : '';
    if (step !== null) {
      $('card2-value').textContent = fmtInt(step) + ' 步';
      $('card2-note').textContent = joinParts([
        planned !== null && planned > 0 ? '计划 ' + fmtInt(planned) + ' 步（' + ((step / planned) * 100).toFixed(1) + '%）' : '未登记总量（不显示百分比）',
        rolloutLine || null
      ]);
    } else if (rollouts && num(rollouts.completed_rollouts) !== null) {
      $('card2-value').textContent = 'rollout ' + fmtInt(rollouts.completed_rollouts) + (num(rollouts.expected_rollouts) !== null ? ' / ' + fmtInt(rollouts.expected_rollouts) : '');
      $('card2-note').textContent = rolloutLine;
    } else {
      $('card2-value').textContent = '尚未测量';
      $('card2-note').textContent = '等待 current_run.step 或 rollouts 计数';
    }

    /* 卡片 ③ */
    var elapsed = obj(current) ? num(current.elapsed_s) : null;
    var elapsedNote = 'elapsed_s';
    if (elapsed === null && matched) {
      var startedMs = parseMs(matched.started_at);
      if (startedMs !== null) {
        elapsed = Math.max(0, (Date.now() - startedMs) / 1000);
        elapsedNote = '按 runs[].started_at 估算';
      }
    }
    var speed = obj(current) ? num(current.speed) : null;
    var speedUnit = obj(current) && hasText(current.speed_unit) ? str(current.speed_unit) : 'step/s';
    if (elapsed !== null) {
      $('card3-value').textContent = fmtDuration(elapsed);
      $('card3-note').textContent = joinParts([
        '用时来自 ' + elapsedNote,
        speed !== null && speed > 0 ? '速度 ' + speed.toFixed(2) + ' ' + speedUnit : '速度尚未测量',
        speed !== null && speed > 0 && planned !== null && step !== null && planned > step
          ? '估计剩余 ' + fmtDuration((planned - step) / speed) + '（按当前速度估计，非承诺）'
          : (planned === null ? '未登记总量，无法估计剩余' : (speed === null ? '无速度，不估计剩余' : '已完成或无需剩余'))
      ]);
    } else {
      $('card3-value').textContent = '尚未测量';
      $('card3-note').textContent = '等待 current_run.elapsed_s 或 runs[].started_at';
    }

    /* 卡片 ④ */
    var gpus = arr(obj(obj(st) && st.resources) && st.resources.gpus);
    if (gpus.length) {
      var used = 0, total = 0, maxUtil = null, counted = 0;
      gpus.forEach(function (g) {
        var u = num(g && g.memory_used_mib), t = num(g && g.memory_total_mib), util = num(g && g.utilization_pct);
        if (u !== null) used += u;
        if (t !== null) total += t;
        if (u !== null || t !== null) counted += 1;
        if (util !== null && (maxUtil === null || util > maxUtil)) maxUtil = util;
      });
      $('card4-value').textContent = counted ? (fmtGiB(used) || '尚未测量') + (total ? ' / ' + fmtGiB(total) : '') : '尚未测量';
      $('card4-note').textContent = joinParts([
        maxUtil !== null ? '最大利用率 ' + maxUtil.toFixed(0) + '%' : '利用率尚未测量',
        '共 ' + gpus.length + ' 张物理 GPU（求和仅针对不同物理卡）'
      ]);
    } else {
      $('card4-value').textContent = '尚未测量';
      $('card4-note').textContent = '等待 resources.gpus';
    }
  }

  function findRun(runs, method, platform, seed) {
    var target = str(method).trim().toLowerCase();
    var candidates = runs.filter(function (r) { return runMethod(r).toLowerCase() === target; });
    if (platform) {
      var byPlatform = candidates.filter(function (r) { return str(r.platform).toLowerCase() === str(platform).toLowerCase(); });
      if (byPlatform.length) candidates = byPlatform;
    }
    if (num(seed) !== null) {
      var bySeed = candidates.filter(function (r) { return num(r.seed) === num(seed); });
      if (bySeed.length) candidates = bySeed;
    }
    return candidates.length ? candidates[0] : null;
  }

  /* ---------- charts ---------- */
  function seriesPoints(series) {
    var raw = arr(series && series.points);
    var stepAllNull = raw.every(function (p) { return num(p && p.step) === null; });
    var pts = [];
    raw.forEach(function (p) {
      var y = num(p && p.value);
      var x = num(p && (stepAllNull ? p.t : p.step));
      if (y === null || x === null) return;
      pts.push({ x: x, y: y, t: num(p && p.t) });
    });
    pts.sort(function (a, b) { return a.x - b.x; });
    return { points: pts, xIsTime: stepAllNull && pts.length > 0 };
  }

  function downsample(points) {
    if (points.length <= MAX_POINTS_DRAWN) return points;
    var stride = Math.ceil(points.length / MAX_POINTS_DRAWN);
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < points.length; i += stride) out.push(points[i]);
    if (out[out.length - 1] !== points[points.length - 1]) out.push(points[points.length - 1]);
    return out;
  }

  function niceTicks(min, max, count) {
    if (!isFinite(min) || !isFinite(max)) return { lo: 0, hi: 1, ticks: [0, 1] };
    if (min === max) {
      var pad = Math.abs(min) > 0 ? Math.abs(min) * 0.1 : 0.5;
      min -= pad; max += pad;
    }
    var raw = (max - min) / Math.max(1, count);
    var mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(raw)));
    var norm = raw / mag;
    var step = (norm <= 1 ? 1 : norm <= 2 ? 2 : norm <= 5 ? 5 : 10) * mag;
    var lo = Math.floor(min / step) * step;
    var hi = Math.ceil(max / step) * step;
    var ticks = [];
    for (var v = lo; v <= hi + step * 1e-9; v += step) ticks.push(Number(v.toFixed(10)));
    return { lo: lo, hi: hi, ticks: ticks };
  }

  function fmtTick(value) {
    var abs = Math.abs(value);
    if (value === 0) return '0';
    if (abs >= 100000) return (value / 1000).toFixed(0) + 'k';
    if (abs >= 1000) return Math.round(value).toLocaleString('zh-CN');
    if (abs >= 1) return String(Number(value.toFixed(2)));
    if (abs >= 0.01) return String(Number(value.toFixed(3)));
    return Number(value.toPrecision(2)).toString();
  }

  function createChart(canvasId, readoutId, emptyText) {
    var canvas = $(canvasId);
    var readout = $(readoutId);
    var cfg = null;
    var hover = null;

    function plot() {
      var dpr = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
      var width = Math.max(260, canvas.clientWidth || 600);
      var height = canvas.clientHeight || 238;
      canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
      canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);
      var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
      var gridColor = cssVar('--border');
      var textColor = cssVar('--muted');
      var strongColor = cssVar('--text');

      var series = cfg ? cfg.series.filter(function (s) { return s.points.length; }) : [];
      var pad = CHART_PAD;
      if (!series.length) {
        ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
        ctx.font = '12px system-ui, sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(emptyText, width / 2, height / 2);
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        return;
      }

      var xMin = Infinity, xMax = -Infinity, yMin = Infinity, yMax = -Infinity;
      series.forEach(function (s) {
        s.points.forEach(function (p) {
          if (p.x < xMin) xMin = p.x;
          if (p.x > xMax) xMax = p.x;
          if (p.y < yMin) yMin = p.y;
          if (p.y > yMax) yMax = p.y;
        });
      });
      if (xMin === xMax) { xMin -= 1; xMax += 1; }
      var xPad = (xMax - xMin) * 0.04;
      xMin -= xPad; xMax += xPad;
      if (xMin < 0 && xMin + xPad >= 0) xMin = 0;

      var logOk = cfg.logScale && yMin > 0 && yMax > 0;
      var lo, hi, yTicks;
      if (logOk) {
        var e0 = Math.floor(Math.log10(yMin));
        var e1 = Math.ceil(Math.log10(yMax));
        if (e1 - e0 > 6) e1 = e0 + 6;
        lo = Math.pow(10, e0); hi = Math.pow(10, e1);
        yTicks = [];
        for (var e = e0; e <= e1; e++) yTicks.push(Math.pow(10, e));
        if (yTicks.length < 2) yTicks = [lo, hi];
      } else {
        var yScale = niceTicks(yMin, yMax * 1.02, 4);
        lo = yScale.lo; hi = yScale.hi; yTicks = yScale.ticks;
      }

      var innerW = width - pad.l - pad.r;
      var innerH = height - pad.t - pad.b;
      var X = function (v) { return pad.l + innerW * (v - xMin) / (xMax - xMin); };
      var Y = function (v) {
        if (logOk) {
          var a = Math.log10(Math.max(v, lo)), b = Math.log10(lo), c = Math.log10(hi);
          return pad.t + innerH * (1 - (a - b) / (c - b));
        }
        return pad.t + innerH * (1 - (v - lo) / (hi - lo));
      };

      ctx.font = '11px system-ui, sans-serif';
      /* 横向网格 + y 轴刻度 */
      ctx.strokeStyle = gridColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
      ctx.textAlign = 'right';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      yTicks.forEach(function (v) {
        var y = Y(v);
        if (y < pad.t - 1 || y > pad.t + innerH + 1) return;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(pad.l, y);
        ctx.lineTo(pad.l + innerW, y);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillText(fmtTick(v), pad.l - 8, y);
      });
      /* 纵向网格 + x 轴刻度 */
      var xTickCount = innerW < 380 ? 3 : 5;
      ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
      for (var i = 0; i <= xTickCount; i++) {
        var xv = xMin + (xMax - xMin) * i / xTickCount;
        var x = X(xv);
        ctx.strokeStyle = gridColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, pad.t);
        ctx.lineTo(x, pad.t + innerH);
        ctx.stroke();
        if (!(cfg.xIsTime)) {
          ctx.textAlign = i === 0 ? 'left' : (i === xTickCount ? 'right' : 'center');
          ctx.fillText(fmtTick(xv), x, pad.t + innerH + 7);
        }
      }
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      if (cfg.xIsTime) {
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.fillText('时间戳起点 ' + fmtTick(xMin), pad.l, pad.t + innerH + 7);
        ctx.textAlign = 'right';
        ctx.fillText('时间戳终点 ' + fmtTick(xMax), pad.l + innerW, pad.t + innerH + 7);
      }
      /* 坐标轴 */
      ctx.strokeStyle = textColor;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(pad.l, pad.t);
      ctx.lineTo(pad.l, pad.t + innerH);
      ctx.lineTo(pad.l + innerW, pad.t + innerH);
      ctx.stroke();
      /* 轴标题 */
      ctx.fillStyle = strongColor;
      ctx.font = '11.5px system-ui, sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
      ctx.fillText(cfg.xTitle || '', pad.l + innerW / 2, height - 4);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(13, pad.t + innerH / 2);
      ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText(cfg.yTitle || '', 0, 0);
      ctx.restore();
      /* 曲线 */
      series.forEach(function (s) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        ctx.beginPath();
        s.points.forEach(function (p, idx) {
          var x = X(p.x), y = Y(p.y);
          if (idx === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        });
        ctx.stroke();
        if (s.points.length === 1) {
          ctx.fillStyle = s.color;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(X(s.points[0].x), Y(s.points[0].y), 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      });
      /* 悬停读数 */
      if (hover && hover.seriesIndex < series.length) {
        var s2 = series[hover.seriesIndex];
        var p2 = s2.points[hover.pointIndex];
        if (p2) {
          var hx = X(p2.x), hy = Y(p2.y);
          ctx.strokeStyle = gridColor;
          ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(hx, pad.t);
          ctx.lineTo(hx, pad.t + innerH);
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.setLineDash([]);
          ctx.fillStyle = s2.color;
          ctx.strokeStyle = cssVar('--panel');
          ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(hx, hy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
    }

    function nearestPoint(px, py) {
      if (!cfg) return null;
      var best = null;
      cfg.series.forEach(function (s, si) {
        if (!s.points.length) return;
        var span = s.points.length > 1 ? Math.abs(s.points[s.points.length - 1]._px - s.points[0]._px) : 0;
        var spacing = s.points.length > 1 ? span / (s.points.length - 1) : 60;
        var limit = Math.max(22, Math.min(80, spacing / 2));
        s.points.forEach(function (p, pi) {
          var dx = Math.abs(p._px - px);
          if (dx > limit) return;
          var dy = Math.abs(p._py - py);
          var score = dx + dy * 0.35;
          if (!best || score < best.score) best = { seriesIndex: si, pointIndex: pi, score: score };
        });
      });
      return best;
    }

    function computePixels() {
      if (!cfg) return;
      var width = Math.max(260, canvas.clientWidth || 600);
      var height = canvas.clientHeight || 238;
      var pad = CHART_PAD;
      var all = cfg.series.filter(function (s) { return s.points.length; });
      if (!all.length) return;
      var xMin = Infinity, xMax = -Infinity, yMin = Infinity, yMax = -Infinity;
      all.forEach(function (s) {
        s.points.forEach(function (p) {
          if (p.x < xMin) xMin = p.x;
          if (p.x > xMax) xMax = p.x;
          if (p.y < yMin) yMin = p.y;
          if (p.y > yMax) yMax = p.y;
        });
      });
      if (xMin === xMax) { xMin -= 1; xMax += 1; }
      var xPad = (xMax - xMin) * 0.04;
      xMin -= xPad; xMax += xPad;
      if (xMin < 0 && xMin + xPad >= 0) xMin = 0;
      var logOk = cfg.logScale && yMin > 0 && yMax > 0;
      var lo, hi;
      if (logOk) {
        var e0 = Math.floor(Math.log10(yMin)), e1 = Math.ceil(Math.log10(yMax));
        if (e1 - e0 > 6) e1 = e0 + 6;
        lo = Math.pow(10, e0); hi = Math.pow(10, e1);
      } else {
        var ys = niceTicks(yMin, yMax * 1.02, 4);
        lo = ys.lo; hi = ys.hi;
      }
      var innerW = width - pad.l - pad.r;
      var innerH = height - pad.t - pad.b;
      cfg.series.forEach(function (s) {
        s.points.forEach(function (p) {
          p._px = pad.l + innerW * (p.x - xMin) / (xMax - xMin);
          if (logOk) {
            var a = Math.log10(Math.max(p.y, lo)), b = Math.log10(lo), c = Math.log10(hi);
            p._py = pad.t + innerH * (1 - (a - b) / (c - b));
          } else {
            p._py = pad.t + innerH * (1 - (p.y - lo) / (hi - lo));
          }
        });
      });
    }

    canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', function (evt) {
      if (!cfg || !cfg.series.length) return;
      var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      var hit = nearestPoint(evt.clientX - rect.left, evt.clientY - rect.top);
      if (!hit) {
        if (hover) { hover = null; plot(); readout.textContent = cfg.hint; }
        return;
      }
      hover = hit;
      var s = cfg.series[hit.seriesIndex];
      var p = s.points[hit.pointIndex];
      readout.textContent = s.label + '（' + unitLabel(s.unit) + '）· ' + (cfg.xIsTime ? '时间 ' + new Date(p.x * 1000).toLocaleString('zh-CN', { hour12: false }) : 'step ' + fmtInt(p.x)) + ' = ' + p.y.toFixed(4);
      plot();
    });
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () {
      if (!cfg) return;
      hover = null;
      plot();
      readout.textContent = cfg.hint;
    });

    return {
      set: function (nextCfg) {
        cfg = nextCfg;
        hover = null;
        computePixels();
        plot();
      },
      redraw: function () {
        computePixels();
        plot();
      },
      hint: function () { return cfg ? cfg.hint : ''; }
    };
  }

  var lossChart = null, succChart = null;

  function buildSeries(raw, spec) {
    var parsed = seriesPoints(raw);
    var points = downsample(parsed.points);
    return {
      label: hasText(raw && raw.label) ? str(raw.label) : spec.label,
      unit: hasText(raw && raw.unit) ? str(raw.unit) : spec.unit,
      name: str(raw && raw.name),
      points: points,
      totalPoints: parsed.points.length,
      color: cssVar(spec.color),
      xIsTime: parsed.xIsTime
    };
  }

  function findSeries(name) {
    var list = arr(obj(S.metrics) && S.metrics.series);
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      if (list[i] && str(list[i].name).trim() === name) return list[i];
    }
    return null;
  }

  function legendHtml(container, series) {
    container.replaceChildren();
    series.forEach(function (s) {
      if (!s.points.length && !s.totalPoints) return;
      var span = el('span');
      var swatch = el('i');
      swatch.style.background = s.color;
      swatch.style.display = 'inline-block';
      span.appendChild(swatch);
      span.appendChild(document.createTextNode(s.label + '（' + unitLabel(s.unit) + '）'));
      container.appendChild(span);
    });
    if (!container.childNodes.length) {
      container.appendChild(el('span', null, '暂无数据（曲线尚无点）'));
    }
  }

  function renderMetrics() {
    var hasMetrics = obj(S.metrics);
    var rawTrain = findSeries('train_action_loss');
    var rawVal = findSeries('val_action_loss');
    var rawSucc = findSeries('dev_success_rate');

    var trainSeries = rawTrain ? buildSeries(rawTrain, { label: '训练 action loss', unit: 'loss', color: '--blue' }) : null;
    var valSeries = rawVal ? buildSeries(rawVal, { label: '固定验证 action loss', unit: 'loss', color: '--green' }) : null;
    var lossSeries = [trainSeries, valSeries].filter(function (s) { return s && (s.points.length || s.totalPoints); });

    var lossCfg = {
      series: lossSeries,
      logScale: window.__n01LossLog !== false,
      xTitle: lossSeries.some(function (s) { return s.xIsTime; }) ? '时间戳（点序列）' : '训练步数 (step)',
      yTitle: '动作 loss',
      xIsTime: lossSeries.length ? lossSeries[0].xIsTime : false,
      hint: '把指针移到曲线附近可读取该点数值'
    };
    if (!lossSeries.length) {
      lossCfg.hint = hasMetrics ? '暂无数据：api/metrics 未返回 train_action_loss / val_action_loss' : '暂无数据：等待 api/metrics';
    }
    legendHtml($('loss-legend'), lossSeries);
    lossChart.set(lossCfg);
    var lossFoot = [];
    lossFoot.push('来源 api/metrics');
    lossFoot.push(trainSeries && trainSeries.totalPoints ? '训练 ' + fmtInt(trainSeries.totalPoints) + ' 点' : '训练曲线暂无数据');
    lossFoot.push(valSeries && valSeries.totalPoints ? '固定验证 ' + fmtInt(valSeries.totalPoints) + ' 点' : '固定验证曲线暂无数据');
    lossFoot.push('绘制上限 ' + fmtInt(MAX_POINTS_DRAWN) + ' 点，超出按等距抽样');
    if (window.__n01LossLog !== false && ((trainSeries && trainSeries.points.some(function (p) { return p.y <= 0; })) || (valSeries && valSeries.points.some(function (p) { return p.y <= 0; })))) {
      lossFoot.push('存在非正 loss，坐标自动使用线性');
    }
    if (S.metricsError && hasMetrics) lossFoot.push('最近一次指标请求失败：' + (S.metricsError.message || S.metricsError.name) + '，显示上次成功数据');
    if (!hasMetrics && S.metricsError) lossFoot.push('读取 api/metrics 失败：' + (S.metricsError.message || S.metricsError.name));
    $('loss-foot').textContent = lossFoot.join(' · ');

    var succSeries = rawSucc ? [buildSeries(rawSucc, { label: '开发闭环成功率', unit: 'ratio', color: '--green' })] : [];
    var succCfg = {
      series: succSeries,
      logScale: false,
      xTitle: '训练步数 (step)',
      yTitle: '开发闭环成功率（' + unitLabel(succSeries.length ? succSeries[0].unit : 'ratio') + '）',
      xIsTime: succSeries.length ? succSeries[0].xIsTime : false,
      hint: '把指针移到曲线附近可读取该点数值'
    };
    if (!succSeries.length) {
      succCfg.hint = hasMetrics ? '暂无数据：api/metrics 未返回 dev_success_rate' : '暂无数据：等待 api/metrics';
    }
    legendHtml($('succ-legend'), succSeries);
    succChart.set(succCfg);
    var succFoot = ['来源 api/metrics：dev_success_rate'];
    if (succSeries.length && succSeries[0].totalPoints) succFoot.push(fmtInt(succSeries[0].totalPoints) + ' 点');
    succFoot.push('与 loss 分属两张图，两轴均标注单位与名称');
    $('succ-foot').textContent = succFoot.join(' · ');
  }

  /* ---------- 四臂矩阵 ---------- */
  function armCell(runs) {
    var cell = el('td');
    if (!runs.length) {
      cell.appendChild(el('span', 'arm-empty', '尚未登记'));
      return cell;
    }
    runs.forEach(function (run) {
      var line = el('div', 'arm-row');
      var method = el('span', 'cell-method', runMethod(run) || '方法未登记');
      line.appendChild(method);
      if (hasText(run.platform)) line.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' · ' + str(run.platform)));
      var stepTxt = num(run.step) === null
        ? 'step 尚未测量'
        : 'step ' + fmtInt(run.step) + (num(run.planned_steps) !== null && num(run.planned_steps) > 0 ? ' / ' + fmtInt(run.planned_steps) : ' / 未登记总量');
      line.appendChild(el('div', 'hint', stepTxt));
      line.appendChild(el('div', 'hint', runStateText(run)));
      var rollout = obj(run.rollouts);
      if (rollout) {
        line.appendChild(el('div', 'hint', joinParts([
          num(rollout.successes) !== null ? '开发闭环成功 ' + fmtInt(rollout.successes) : '成功数尚未记录',
          num(rollout.expected_rollouts) !== null ? '分母 ' + fmtInt(rollout.expected_rollouts) : '分母未登记',
          num(rollout.failures) !== null ? '正常失败 ' + fmtInt(rollout.failures) : null,
          num(rollout.infra_pending) !== null ? 'infra 待恢复 ' + fmtInt(rollout.infra_pending) : null,
          num(rollout.completed_rollouts) !== null ? '已完成 ' + fmtInt(rollout.completed_rollouts) : null
        ])));
        if (hasText(rollout.note)) line.appendChild(el('span', 'chip', str(rollout.note)));
      } else {
        line.appendChild(el('div', 'hint', '开发闭环尚未记录'));
      }
      cell.appendChild(line);
    });
    return cell;
  }

  function runStateText(run) {
    var parts = [];
    var phase = hasText(run.phase) ? str(run.phase) : '';
    if (phase) parts.push('阶段 ' + phase);
    var info = exitInfo(run);
    parts.push(info.text);
    if (hasText(run.exit_reason) && run.alive !== false) parts.push('退出原因 ' + str(run.exit_reason));
    return parts.join(' · ');
  }

  function renderArmTable(st) {
    var runs = arr(obj(st) && st.runs);
    var body = $('arm-body');
    body.replaceChildren();
    [['RAW', 'raw_base', 'raw_n01'], ['RGB', 'rgb_base', 'rgb_n01']].forEach(function (row) {
      var tr = el('tr');
      tr.appendChild(el('th', null, row[0]));
      tr.appendChild(armCell(runs.filter(function (r) { return armKeyOf(runMethod(r)) === row[1]; })));
      tr.appendChild(armCell(runs.filter(function (r) { return armKeyOf(runMethod(r)) === row[2]; })));
      body.appendChild(tr);
    });
    var seeds = {};
    runs.forEach(function (r) { var s = num(r && r.seed); if (s !== null) seeds[s] = true; });
    var seedList = Object.keys(seeds);
    $('arm-foot').textContent = joinParts([
      '每格为 runs 中按 method 匹配的真实记录（含各平台分行）',
      '本矩阵仅 1 个训练种子，默认 101',
      seedList.length ? '当前出现过的种子：' + seedList.join('、') : '尚未出现种子记录',
      runs.length ? null : 'runs 尚未登记'
    ]);
  }

  /* ---------- GPU / 作业表 ---------- */
  function renderGpuTable(st) {
    var resources = obj(obj(st) && st.resources);
    var gpus = arr(resources && resources.gpus);
    var runs = arr(obj(st) && st.runs);
    var devloop = obj(resources && resources.dev_loop);
    var body = $('gpu-body');
    body.replaceChildren();

    var domains = [];
    runs.forEach(function (r) {
      var d = domainOf(r) || '未标输入域';
      if (domains.indexOf(d) < 0) domains.push(d);
    });
    ['RAW', 'RGB'].forEach(function (d) { if (domains.indexOf(d) < 0 && runs.length) domains.push(d); });
    if (!runs.length && gpus.length) {
      gpus.forEach(function (g, idx) {
        domains.push(hasText(g && g.queue) ? str(g.queue).toUpperCase() : ('物理 GPU #' + (num(g && g.index) !== null ? fmtInt(g.index) : idx)));
      });
    }

    if (!domains.length) {
      var trEmpty = el('tr');
      var tdEmpty = el('td', 'arm-empty', gpus.length ? '尚未登记 runs（仅有物理 GPU 记录）' : '尚未登记 GPU / 作业记录');
      tdEmpty.colSpan = 6;
      trEmpty.appendChild(tdEmpty);
      body.appendChild(trEmpty);
    }

    domains.forEach(function (domain) {
      var workerRuns = runs.filter(function (r) { return (domainOf(r) || '未标输入域') === domain; });
      var workerGpus = gpus.filter(function (g) {
        var queue = str(g && g.queue).toUpperCase();
        if (queue && (queue === domain || queue.indexOf(domain) >= 0)) return true;
        var job = str(g && g.job).toLowerCase();
        return workerRuns.some(function (r) { return hasText(runMethod(r)) && job.indexOf(runMethod(r).toLowerCase()) >= 0; });
      });
      var tr = el('tr');
      /* 物理 GPU */
      var gpuCell = el('td');
      if (workerGpus.length) {
        workerGpus.forEach(function (g, i) {
          var idx = num(g && g.index);
          gpuCell.appendChild(el('div', null, '#' + (idx === null ? '?' : fmtInt(idx)) + (hasText(g && g.name) ? ' ' + str(g.name) : '')));
          if (i === 0 && hasText(g && g.job)) gpuCell.appendChild(el('div', 'hint', 'job ' + str(g.job)));
        });
      } else {
        gpuCell.appendChild(el('span', 'arm-empty', '未登记'));
      }
      tr.appendChild(gpuCell);
      /* 作业 */
      var jobCell = el('td');
      jobCell.appendChild(el('div', null, domain + ' 作业'));
      if (workerRuns.length) {
        jobCell.appendChild(el('div', 'hint', workerRuns.map(function (r) {
          return runMethod(r) + (hasText(r.platform) ? '(' + str(r.platform) + (num(r.seed) !== null ? ', seed ' + fmtInt(r.seed) : '') + ')' : '');
        }).join(' · ')));
      } else {
        jobCell.appendChild(el('div', 'hint', '尚未登记 runs'));
      }
      tr.appendChild(jobCell);
      /* 阶段 */
      var phaseCell = el('td');
      var phases = [];
      workerRuns.forEach(function (r) { var p = str(r.phase); if (p && phases.indexOf(p) < 0) phases.push(p); });
      phaseCell.textContent = phases.length ? phases.join(' / ') : '尚未测量';
      tr.appendChild(phaseCell);
      /* step / rollout */
      var stepCell = el('td', 'num');
      if (workerRuns.length) {
        workerRuns.slice(0, 2).forEach(function (r) {
          var parts = [];
          parts.push(num(r.step) !== null ? 'step ' + fmtInt(r.step) + (num(r.planned_steps) !== null && num(r.planned_steps) > 0 ? ' / ' + fmtInt(r.planned_steps) : ' / 未登记总量') : 'step 尚未测量');
          var ro = obj(r.rollouts);
          if (ro && num(ro.completed_rollouts) !== null) parts.push('rollout ' + fmtInt(ro.completed_rollouts) + (num(ro.expected_rollouts) !== null ? ' / ' + fmtInt(ro.expected_rollouts) : ''));
          stepCell.appendChild(el('div', null, parts.join(' · ')));
        });
        if (workerRuns.length > 2) stepCell.appendChild(el('div', 'hint', '另有 ' + (workerRuns.length - 2) + ' 个 run，见运行明细'));
      } else {
        stepCell.appendChild(el('div', null, '尚未测量'));
      }
      tr.appendChild(stepCell);
      /* 显存 */
      var memCell = el('td', 'num');
      if (workerGpus.length) {
        workerGpus.forEach(function (g) {
          var used = fmtGiB(g && g.memory_used_mib);
          var total = fmtGiB(g && g.memory_total_mib);
          var util = num(g && g.utilization_pct);
          memCell.appendChild(el('div', null, used || total ? (used || '?') + ' / ' + (total || '?') : '尚未测量'));
          memCell.appendChild(el('div', 'hint', util !== null ? '利用率 ' + util.toFixed(0) + '%' : '利用率尚未测量'));
        });
      } else {
        memCell.appendChild(el('div', null, '尚未测量'));
      }
      tr.appendChild(memCell);
      /* 最后心跳 */
      var hbCell = el('td');
      if (workerRuns.length) {
        var times = workerRuns.map(function (r) { return parseMs(r.updated_at); }).filter(function (v) { return v !== null; });
        if (times.length) {
          var latest = Math.max.apply(null, times);
          hbCell.appendChild(el('div', 'numbers', new Date(latest).toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour12: false })));
          hbCell.appendChild(el('div', 'hint', fmtAge(Date.now() - latest) + '前'));
        } else {
          hbCell.appendChild(el('span', 'arm-empty', '未登记 updated_at'));
        }
      } else {
        hbCell.appendChild(el('span', 'arm-empty', '未登记'));
      }
      tr.appendChild(hbCell);
      body.appendChild(tr);
    });

    /* 开发闭环全局 */
    var chip = $('devloop-chip');
    var line = $('devloop-line');
    if (devloop) {
      var completed = num(devloop.completed_rollouts);
      var budget = num(devloop.budget_rollouts);
      if (budget === null) budget = 100;
      chip.textContent = completed !== null ? '开发闭环已完成 ' + fmtInt(completed) + ' / ' + fmtInt(budget) : '开发闭环总量已登记，完成数尚未记录';
      chip.setAttribute('data-tone', 'ok');
      var groups = arr(devloop.by_method);
      var parts = ['全局分母取自 resources.dev_loop.budget_rollouts（缺省 100）：' + (completed !== null ? fmtInt(completed) : '尚未测量') + ' / ' + fmtInt(budget)];
      if (groups.length) {
        parts.push('各 worker 各按自己的分母：' + groups.map(function (g) {
          return str(g && g.method) + ' ' + (num(g && g.completed_rollouts) !== null ? fmtInt(g.completed_rollouts) : '?') + ' / ' + (num(g && g.expected_rollouts) !== null ? fmtInt(g.expected_rollouts) : '未登记分母') +
            joinParts([
              num(g && g.successes) !== null ? '成功 ' + fmtInt(g.successes) : null,
              num(g && g.failures) !== null ? '正常失败 ' + fmtInt(g.failures) : null,
              num(g && g.infra_pending) !== null ? 'infra 待恢复 ' + fmtInt(g.infra_pending) : null
            ], '，');
        }).join('；'));
      }
      var mode = hasText(devloop.aggregate) ? str(devloop.aggregate).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
      if (mode === 'sum') {
        parts.push('服务端按 method 相加汇总（各 worker 各自占用开发闭环分区），全局分母仍为 budget_rollouts，不把每个 worker 的 100 再乘一遍');
      } else if (mode === 'max') {
        parts.push('服务端取最大（保守，不把并行 worker 相加成双倍）');
      } else {
        parts.push('并行两个 worker 各自记录，本页不做跨卡求和（不会把两个 100 相加成 200）');
      }
      if (hasText(devloop.note)) parts.push('服务端说明：' + str(devloop.note));
      line.textContent = parts.join('　|　');
    } else {
      chip.textContent = '开发闭环总量未登记';
      chip.setAttribute('data-tone', 'muted');
      line.textContent = '等待 resources.dev_loop（completed_rollouts / budget_rollouts / by_method）；此处不推算、不填 0。';
    }
    $('gpu-foot').textContent = '物理 GPU 显存为各卡自身读数；显存求和只在卡片④对不同物理卡进行，rollout 预算不做任何跨 worker 相加。';
  }

  /* ---------- 运行明细 ---------- */
  function renderRuns(st) {
    var runs = arr(obj(st) && st.runs);
    var resources = obj(obj(st) && st.resources);
    var body = $('runs-body');
    body.replaceChildren();
    if (!runs.length) {
      var tr = el('tr');
      var td = el('td', 'arm-empty', obj(st) ? 'runs 尚未登记' : '等待 api/status');
      td.colSpan = 10;
      tr.appendChild(td);
      body.appendChild(tr);
    }
    runs.forEach(function (run) {
      var tr = el('tr');
      tr.appendChild(el('td', null, runMethod(run) || '未登记'));
      tr.appendChild(el('td', null, domainOf(run) || '未登记'));
      var kindCell = el('td');
      kindCell.appendChild(el('div', null, dataKindLabel(run.data_kind) || '未登记'));
      if (hasText(run.data_kind)) kindCell.appendChild(el('code', 'hint', str(run.data_kind)));
      tr.appendChild(kindCell);
      tr.appendChild(el('td', null, hasText(run.platform) ? str(run.platform) : '未登记'));
      tr.appendChild(el('td', 'num', num(run.seed) !== null ? fmtInt(run.seed) : '未登记'));
      var stateCell = el('td');
      var chip = el('span', 'chip', !hasText(run.phase) && run.alive === undefined ? '状态未登记' : runStateText(run));
      chip.setAttribute('data-tone', exitInfo(run).tone);
      stateCell.appendChild(chip);
      tr.appendChild(stateCell);
      tr.appendChild(el('td', 'num', num(run.step) !== null
        ? fmtInt(run.step) + ' / ' + (num(run.planned_steps) !== null && num(run.planned_steps) > 0 ? fmtInt(run.planned_steps) : '未登记总量')
        : '尚未测量'));
      var ro = obj(run.rollouts);
      var roCell = el('td', 'num');
      if (ro) {
        roCell.appendChild(el('div', null, joinParts([
          (num(ro.completed_rollouts) !== null ? fmtInt(ro.completed_rollouts) : '?') + ' / ' + (num(ro.expected_rollouts) !== null ? fmtInt(ro.expected_rollouts) : '未登记分母'),
          num(ro.successes) !== null ? '成功 ' + fmtInt(ro.successes) : null,
          num(ro.failures) !== null ? '正常失败 ' + fmtInt(ro.failures) : null,
          num(ro.infra_pending) !== null ? 'infra 待恢复 ' + fmtInt(ro.infra_pending) : null
        ], '　')));
        if (hasText(ro.note)) roCell.appendChild(el('span', 'chip', str(ro.note)));
      } else {
        roCell.appendChild(el('span', 'arm-empty', '尚未记录'));
      }
      tr.appendChild(roCell);
      var rateCell = el('td', 'num');
      if (ro && num(ro.successes) !== null && num(ro.failures) !== null && (num(ro.successes) + num(ro.failures)) > 0) {
        rateCell.appendChild(el('div', null, (num(ro.successes) / (num(ro.successes) + num(ro.failures)) * 100).toFixed(1) + '%'));
        rateCell.appendChild(el('div', 'hint', '暂时结果（按已判定 ' + fmtInt(num(ro.successes) + num(ro.failures)) + ' 次）'));
        if (num(ro.expected_rollouts) !== null) rateCell.appendChild(el('div', 'hint', '原正式分母 ' + fmtInt(ro.expected_rollouts)));
      } else {
        rateCell.appendChild(el('span', 'arm-empty', '尚未测量'));
      }
      tr.appendChild(rateCell);
      var hb = parseMs(run.updated_at);
      tr.appendChild(el('td', null, hb === null ? '未登记 updated_at' : new Date(hb).toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour12: false }) + '（' + fmtAge(Date.now() - hb) + '前）'));
      body.appendChild(tr);
    });

    $('runs-chip').textContent = runs.length ? fmtInt(runs.length) + ' 个 run' : '等待 runs';
    var note = [];
    note.push('每行一个 (方法 × 平台 × 种子) 真实 run；分段分母与全量分母分别显示，不自动按平台或方法乘开。');
    note.push('数据来源按 data_kind 标注：LIBERO 逆处理/量化缓存（libero_dequantized、libero_uint8）、RoboTwin HDR 派生（hdr_derived）、真实 CFA（real_cfa）。');
    if (runs.some(function (r) { return obj(r.rollouts) && hasText(r.rollouts.note); })) {
      note.push('rollouts.note 中的阶段标注（如“P4 正式全量”“P5 迁移实验”）按服务端原文显示。');
    }
    $('runs-note').textContent = note.join(' ');

    var p4Line = $('p4-line');
    var total = obj(st) ? num(st.p4_total) : null;
    var extra = obj(st) ? num(st.p4_extra) : null;
    if (total !== null || extra !== null) {
      var coverage = 0, covered = 0;
      var seen = {};
      runs.forEach(function (r) {
        var ro = obj(r.rollouts);
        if (!ro || num(ro.completed_rollouts) === null) return;
        var key = str(r.method) + '|' + str(r.platform) + '|' + str(r.seed);
        if (seen[key]) return;
        seen[key] = true;
        coverage += num(ro.completed_rollouts);
        covered += 1;
      });
      var text = [];
      if (total !== null) text.push('P4 核心期望总量 ' + fmtInt(total) + '（来自 status.p4_total）');
      if (extra !== null) text.push('附加 ' + fmtInt(extra) + ' 另列（来自 status.p4_extra，不并入核心分母）');
      if (covered) text.push('按 runs 去重汇总已完成覆盖 ' + fmtInt(coverage) + (total !== null ? ' / ' + fmtInt(total) + '（' + (coverage / total * 100).toFixed(1) + '%）' : '') + '，覆盖来自 ' + fmtInt(covered) + ' 个 run');

          card.replaceChild(el('div', 'artifact-fail', '图像加载失败：' + rawUrl), img);
        }
      });
      card.appendChild(img);
    }

    var meta = joinParts([
      hasText(a.camera) ? '相机 ' + str(a.camera) : null,
      a.episode !== null && a.episode !== undefined && hasText(a.episode) ? 'episode ' + str(a.episode) : null,
      num(a.frame) !== null ? '帧 ' + fmtInt(a.frame) : null,

      hasText(a.kind) ? '类型 ' + str(a.kind) : null
    ]);

    if (hasText(a.legend)) card.appendChild(el('div', 'artifact-legend', '图例：' + str(a.legend)));
    if (hasText(rawUrl)) card.appendChild(el('code', 'artifact-path', '服务端路径：' + rawUrl));

        if (succChart) succChart.redraw();
      }, 150);
    });
    setInterval(tickClocks, 1000);
    refreshAll();
    loop(pollStatus, BASE_INTERVAL.status);
    loop(pollMetrics, BASE_INTERVAL.metrics);
    loop(pollArtifacts, BASE_INTERVAL.artifacts);
    window.__n01MonitorReady = true;
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }

"""Read-only loopback progress service and writer library for the N01 v1.2 P3 runs.

The service is a single-page monitor for long training/evaluation loops that run on a
remote server with two GPUs (RAW queue on GPU0, RGB queue on GPU1). It is deliberately
small and decoupled from training:

* writers are called by training/evaluation workers and never block training;
* the HTTP service only reads files under ``--run-root`` and never touches torch, models,
  datasets or full logs;
* the page can be closed, the SSH session can drop, or the service can be restarted at
  any time without affecting a single training process.

Storage layout under the run root (nothing outside it is ever read or written)::

    monitor/workers/<role>.json     one file per worker, replaced atomically
    monitor/status.json             aggregated status produced by :func:`reconcile`
    monitor/metrics.jsonl           appended metric points, one JSON object per line
    monitor/logs/<role>.jsonl       appended worker log lines
    monitor/cases/index.json        case index ``{"artifacts": [...]}``
    monitor/artifacts/...           images/videos served by ``GET /artifacts/<path>``
    monitor/gpus.json               last GPU sample (background thread, ~8 s)
    monitor/overrides.json          optional orchestrator state/activity override

Step semantics: :meth:`RunStateWriter.metric` records whatever ``step`` the caller
passes, and callers must pass the real optimizer update step. A gradient-accumulation
micro-step is not an update step and must never be reported as one; passing a micro-step
counter silently rescales every reported curve.

Typical use::

    from owac.runtime.n01_v12_monitor import RunStateWriter

    with RunStateWriter(run_root, "libero-raw_n01-seed101", method="raw_n01",
                        input_domain="RAW", data_kind="hdr_derived",
                        platform="libero", seed=101, planned_steps=50_000,
                        gpu_index=0) as run:
        run.update(step=step, phase="training")
        run.metric("train_action_loss", step=step, value=loss, unit="loss",
